purpose: Teach: 逆襲/脱落/総統/総督/ゆだね/波乱/バイパス/リバウンド

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: シェア逆襲のキャンペーンを準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's start preparing the counter-share campaign.
lines.style: Businesslike and forward-moving. Crisp attack on the opening word. Clear priorities, efficient pacing. No wasted breath — this is a briefing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修で脱落者を出さないよう工夫します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we don't lose anyone in the training process.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Slight nod in the voice on the opening affirmation. Steady, measured delivery. Shows he's already thinking through the logistics.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 総統選挙の動向を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share updates on the presidential election developments.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful. Light emphasis on the key word. Controlled pace, organized tone. Delegating information flow with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。植民地時代の総督史も社員向け雑学に追加します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also add some historical context about colonial governors to the employee knowledge base.
lines.style: Responsive and thorough. Quick acknowledgment, then pivots to an idea of his own. Upbeat undertone — he's thinking ahead and adding value.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人にも責任をゆだねていきましょう
lines.en: We should start giving newer staff more responsibility.
lines.style: Measured, intentional. Slight pause before the core idea — she's chosen her words. Warm but directive tone, the kind that expects buy-in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。波乱含みの一年でしたが乗り切ります
lines.en: Yes. This year's been unpredictable, but we'll get through it.
lines.style: Steady, resilient. Warm undertone beneath the professional surface. Acknowledges difficulty without dwelling on it. Closes with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 物流のバイパス経路を地図化しましょう
lines.en: Let's map out alternative logistics routes.
lines.style: Crisp and solution-focused. Even pacing, practical tone. Speaks as someone moving through a checklist but present in the moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。下落後のリバウンドを期待しています
lines.en: Got it. I'm looking forward to a rebound once things stabilize.
lines.style: Quick, assured. Light optimism in the delivery — not naive, just forward-looking. Closing note of qualified confidence. Natural conversational wrap.
